test_cases.name: Genuine Credit Note Matched in Both Sources
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Exact Credit Note Matching: negative PR taxable signed amount matches positive GSTR-2B CDNR credit note on absolute magnitude without sign penalty.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Input tax credit adjustment under GST Section 34 correctly recognized; buyer liability reduced without audit discrepancy.

test_cases.name: Similar Credit Note Single-Digit Typo Isolation
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Sequential series & typo prevention: CRN-8813 in PR is not falsely collapsed into CRN-8812. In full reconciliation, CRN-8812 matches CRN-8812 cleanly while CRN-8813 remains isolated in ITC at Risk (PR only). In head-to-head evaluation against CRN-8812 alone, the engine routes to REVIEW_REQUIRED as TYPO_MISMATCH and never allows a false clean match.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Prevents unfiled supplier credit notes from falsely extinguishing valid claims.

test_cases.name: Ordinary Invoice Resembling Credit Note Prefix
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Delimiter-Aware Note Detection (_is_note_document): When doc_type is explicitly INVOICE and taxable amount is positive, ordinary invoices with arbitrary prefixes (including CRN-, CNTR-, CNS-, DNA-) are classified as INVOICE and match cleanly without note quarantine or false note handling.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Ensures legitimate business purchases are not improperly diverted to credit note reconciliation pools.

test_cases.name: URP Invoice Clean Match in Both Sources
test_cases.engine_mechanism: URP Deterministic Identity Preservation: GSTR-2B parser groups unregistered vendors by (ctin, supplier_name), enabling exact Level 1 matching when trade name and invoice number align.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Facilitates seamless Section 9(4) Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) audit and reconciliation for unregistered procurement.

test_cases.name: URP Invoice in Purchase Register Only
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Distinct Unregistered Vendor Tracking: Lakshmi Transport Services is preserved as an independent supplier identity without collapsing into City Logistics & Courier, remaining in ITC at Risk (PR Only).
test_cases.statutory_implication: Flags internal accounting entries requiring self-invoicing and reverse charge tax payment.

test_cases.name: URP Invoice in GSTR-2B Only
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Unregistered Supplier Ingestion Integrity: National Security Guard Services appears as an independent Missed ITC entity without acquiring or corrupting names of other URP suppliers.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Alerts CA to portal-reported transactions missing from client accounts books.

test_cases.name: Deliberately Unmatched Credit Note in PR Only
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Unmatched Credit Note Preservation: Correctly categorized under ITC at Risk with doc_type preserved as CREDIT_NOTE.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Audits compliance where buyer has issued/received credit note not yet reported by supplier in GSTR-1.

test_cases.name: Standard Exact Invoice Match Control Anchor
test_cases.engine_mechanism: Phase 1 Level 1 Exact Match: Identical normalized invoice number, supplier GSTIN, and taxable/tax amounts.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Baseline control verifying that standard compliant tax invoices match with 100% precision.

test_cases.name: FP-01 Sequential Billing Series Guard Control
test_cases.engine_mechanism: FP-01 Sequential Series Guard (is_sequential_series_mismatch): Both invoices share similarity ratio 0.75 and 2.8% tax difference under the same supplier, but trailing numeric sequences (1877 vs 1978) indicate distinct billing events. The engine blocks fuzzy matching, keeping GSTR-2B in Missed ITC and PR in ITC at Risk.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Prevents masking ₹54,209.43 in genuine missed ITC while simultaneously preventing wrongful claiming of unfiled purchase credit under Section 16(2)(aa).

test_cases.name: FP-02 Cross-Vendor Supplier Identity Conflict Gate Control
test_cases.engine_mechanism: FP-02 Cross-Supplier Gate (supplier_identity_compatible): Despite high invoice similarity (0.857) and small value difference (4.45%), supplier PANs and state codes differ (27 TESTS0002B vs 33 TESTS0004D). The identity gate blocks fuzzy matching, resulting in IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
test_cases.statutory_implication: Eliminates cross-taxpayer credit contamination and interest/penalty liabilities under Section 50(3).
